name: OPKSSH
description: Connect to hosts with short-lived OpenPubkey SSH certificates after signing in with your identity provider.
features: Adds the OPKSSH auth type to hosts
Sign in with your identity provider in the browser
Certificates last 24 hours, so you sign in once a day
Uses a pinned, checksum verified opkssh release

env.name: OPKSSH_VERSION
env.description: Use another opkssh release than the one Termix pins. Needs OPKSSH_SHA256 too.

env.name: OPKSSH_SHA256
env.description: SHA-256 of the opkssh binary for OPKSSH_VERSION. OPKSSH_SHA256_AMD64 and OPKSSH_SHA256_ARM64 set it per CPU.

env.name: OPKSSH_SHA256_AMD64
env.description: SHA-256 of the x64 binary for OPKSSH_VERSION.

env.name: OPKSSH_SHA256_ARM64
env.description: SHA-256 of the ARM64 binary for OPKSSH_VERSION.

env.name: OPKSSH_BUNDLED_DIR
env.description: Folder with a copy of opkssh baked into the image, used before downloading.
